items.title: Joe Burrow: Offsets modest yardage with TDs
items.text:
Burrow completed 23 of 32 passes for 190 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed four times for 10 yards in the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

items.title: Malik Nabers: Productive on career-high 20 targets
items.text:
Nabers caught 11 of 20 targets for 121 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-27 tie against the Commanders.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: D'Andre Swift: Logs 13 total touches in loss
items.text:
Swift rushed nine times for 43 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 30 yards in the Bears' 31-7 loss to the Packers on Sunday.

items.title: Tyler Shough: Overwhelmed by Vikings in loss
items.text:
Shough completed 16 of 25 passes for 96 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions in the Saints' 23-13 loss to the Vikings on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyler Murray: Sharpest game of season in win
items.text:
Murray completed 24 of 30 passes for 229 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while adding 10 rushes for 51 yards in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the Saints on Sunday. He also recovered a fumble.
